I sent Dana a direct message: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

- **Source:** Dana's own post in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025. They first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 two minutes later. The amendment was signed on 19 Aug 2025.
- **Not checked against the contract:** the shared files don't have the signed amendment, so I couldn't confirm the number from the document itself. I told Dana that June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if they want to check it before the QBR deck.
- **Sharing:** a seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, and Dana owns the account, so no approval was needed.
